answer: An operator copying one text across 179 aliases hence pays for 179 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the kernel hash is stored at intake, the oasis graph groups the endorsements and the jetty audit publishes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
